svg.aria-label: Daily doodle for October 3, 2026 — the 36th anniversary of German Reunification on October 3, 1990. On the left, the Brandenburg Gate: six Doric columns on a stone plinth, an entablature and attic above, and the quadriga — Victoria in her four-horse chariot — silhouetted on top. A warm dawn glow sits behind the gate along the horizon. Fireworks bloom overhead in black, red, and gold with trailing sparks, bursting at prime intervals. On the right, a large cream OCTOBER 3, 2026 headline underlined by a horizontal black-red-gold German flag bar, a gold DEUTSCHE EINHEIT · 36 YEARS subhead, an italic amber TAG DER DEUTSCHEN EINHEIT · OCTOBER 3, 1990 tertiary, a dim BERLIN · BONN · DRESDEN · LEIPZIG · HAMBURG roster, and a Georgia-italic 'Wir sind ein Volk.' caption at the base.
